svg.aria-label: Bode plots of a simple zero 1 + jωT and a simple pole 1/(1 + jωT): the asymptotes are flat to the corner 1/T and then rise or fall at 20 dB per decade; the exact curves are 3 dB away at the corner; the phase goes from 0 to plus or minus 90 degrees, passing 45 degrees at the corner
svg.title: Bode plots of a simple zero 1 + jωT and a simple pole 1/(1 + jωT): the asymptotes are flat to the corner 1/T and then rise or fall at 20 dB per decade; the exact curves are 3 dB away at the corner; the phase goes from 0 to plus or minus 90 degrees, passing 45 degrees at the corner

g.text: dashed: asymptotes · the exact curve is 3 dB off at the corner and 1 dB off an octave either side
